title: One-Roll Temple — What Problems Does It Have

entries.value: A rival faith or shrine is actively doing this one harm
The locals expect a miracle it cannot provide
The leader is fighting with their ecclesiastical superiors
A priest here recently did something awful
The temple has gotten into serious debt
A disaster has physically damaged the building
Some armed men have a grudge against this shrine
The noble class refuse to patronise it for some reason
It shows signs of genuine divine displeasure — withered crops, sick animals
A priest here is meddling with dark powers or forbidden rites
A schismatic preacher is drawing off its believers
Roll twice; one problem was caused by the other
